2607.29353.title: Versatile On-device Adaptation at the Edge by Unifying Few-shot, Zero-shot, Continual, and In-context Learning
2607.29353.paper_summary: With the ever-increasing pervasiveness of smart edge devices, the demand is growing for applications that can be tailored to users (e.g., custom keyword spotting) or patients (e.g., adaptive health monitoring). Yet, most edge devices rely on fixed inference algorithms and thus cannot learn on-device to personalize predictions. When they can, devices typically support only a specific learning scenario, such as few-shot learning (FSL): going beyond this requires resorting either to another specialized device or to cloud-based retraining, which implies significant energy and latency overheads, a lack of real-time capabilities, and privacy concerns. In this work, we introduce embedder-centric learning (ECL), a framework that unifies four different online learning scenarios: FSL for on-the-fly customization, continual learning (CL) for knowledge accumulation, zero-shot learning (ZSL) for leveraging semantic data, and in-context learning (ICL) for adapting beyond classification. We demonstrate in silicon that ECL can be deployed on resource-constrained devices across four real-world use cases representative of the aforementioned learning scenarios. Our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art performance for FSL character recognition (Omniglot: 96.8% for 5-way 1-shot, 83.3% for 32-way 1-shot), and the first hardware baseline for CL in keyword spotting (NeuroBench keyword FSCIL: 71.8% for 200-way 5-shot). Moreover, we present the first hardware demonstrations of ZSL with semantic data (60.6% for 5-way spoken sentence classification) and ICL (46.2% at the 500th token of RegBench) operating at micro-to-milliwatt power budgets. Therefore, by unifying multiple learning scenarios, we pave the way for smart and versatile devices that can adapt right at the edge, without reliance on the cloud.
2607.29353.paper_summary_zh: 隨著智慧邊緣設備的普及程度不斷提高，對於能夠針對用戶（例如，自訂關鍵字偵測）或患者（例如，自適應健康監測）量身定制的應用需求也在增長。然而，大多數邊緣設備依賴於固定的推理算法，因此無法在設備上學習以個性化預測。當設備能夠學習時，通常僅支持特定的學習場景，例如少樣本學習（FSL）：超越這一點需要依賴另一個專用設備或基於雲的再訓練，這意味著顯著的能量和延遲開銷，缺乏實時能力，以及隱私問題。在這項工作中，我們介紹了嵌入中心學習（ECL），這是一個統一四種不同在線學習場景的框架：用於即時自訂的FSL，知識積累的持續學習（CL），利用語義數據的零樣本學習（ZSL），以及超越分類的上下文學習（ICL）。我們在矽片上展示了ECL可以在資源受限的設備上部署，涵蓋四個真實世界的用例，這些用例代表了上述學習場景。我們的方法為FSL字符識別建立了新的最先進性能（Omniglot：5-way 1-shot達96.8%，32-way 1-shot達83.3%），並為關鍵字偵測中的CL提供了第一個硬體基準（NeuroBench關鍵字FSCIL：200-way 5-shot達71.8%）。此外，我們展示了使用語義數據的ZSL（5-way口語句子分類達60.6%）和ICL（在RegBench的第500個標記時達46.2%）的首個硬體演示，這些都在微瓦到毫瓦的功率預算下運行。因此，通過統一多種學習場景，我們為能夠在邊緣進行自適應的智慧且多功能設備鋪平了道路，而無需依賴雲端。
